why: mv-gang round 1, 1:23 'stacks and stacks of elastic cash'
prompt:
A music-video still: a scarred oak table in a cellar counting room piled high with bricks of green banknotes, each brick bound with a red rubber band, the stacks leaning and spilling. A broad robber called PLUM sits behind it and fans one brick of notes out toward the camera like a magician spreading cards, the notes splayed in a sharp arc close to the lens, his other gloved hand flat on the pile. He wears a chalk-striped mustard-yellow three-piece suit, black leather gloves, collar up, and a chunky hand-knitted plum rib wool hood covering head and neck, smooth knit where the face would be, a cream ring chain-stitched round the face, one small rounded red felt triangle high over his right eye, on the left side of the picture. A single green-shaded banker's lamp low on the table lights the money from below and to the side; teal-painted walls fall into shadow. 50mm lens at table height, shallow focus on the fanned notes, soft grain.

Thanks.
